001package dayplanner;
002
003
004/**
005 * <p>
006 * Represents a scheduled activity with a title, start time, end time, and
007 * optional comment.
008 * </p>
009 * <p>
010 * Serves as the base class for {@link HomeActivity}, {@link SchoolActivity},
011 * and {@link OtherActivity}.
012 * </p>
013 * <p>
014 * The class stores its {@link Time} references directly and does not enforce
015 * that the end follows the start; callers creating activities directly should
016 * validate that rule themselves. For example:
017 * </p>
018 * 
019 * <pre>
020 * Time start = new Time(2026, 10, 20, 14, 30);
021 * Time end = new Time(2026, 10, 20, 16, 30);
022 * Activity lab = new SchoolActivity("CIS 2430 Lab", start, end, "Bring laptop");
023 * </pre>
024 */
025public class Activity implements Comparable<Activity> {
026    private String title;   // Required
027    private Time startTime; // Required
028    private Time endTime;   // Required
029    private String comment; // Optional
030
031
032
033    /*
034     * Constructors
035     */
036   
037    /**
038     * <p>
039     * Constructs an <code>Activity</code> with a title, start time, and end time.
040     * </p>
041     * <p>
042     * Null or blank required values are ignored by their setters; construction
043     * therefore does not throw for those values.
044     * </p>
045     * 
046     * @param title     The activity title.
047     * @param startTime The start time.
048     * @param endTime   The end time.
049     */
050    public Activity(String title, Time startTime, Time endTime) {
051        setTitle(title);
052        setStartTime(startTime);
053        setEndTime(endTime);
054    }
055
056    /**
057     * <p>
058     * Constructs an <code>Activity</code> with a title, start time, end time, and
059     * comment.
060     * </p>
061     * <p>
062     * A null or blank comment is ignored, leaving the comment unset.
063     * </p>
064     * 
065     * @param title     The activity title.
066     * @param startTime The start time.
067     * @param endTime   The end time.
068     * @param comment   The activity comment.
069     */
070    public Activity(String title, Time startTime, Time endTime, String comment) {
071        this(title, startTime, endTime);
072        setComment(comment);
073    }
074
075    /**
076     * <p>
077     * Constructs an <code>Activity</code> from a RAS (Readable Activity Serial)
078     * string. Tokens are parsed in the following order:
079     * </p>
080     * <ol>
081     * <li>class name (ignored),</li>
082     * <li>title,</li>
083     * <li>start time,</li>
084     * <li>end time,</li>
085     * <li>comment (<code>NIL</code> is treated as no comment).</li>
086     * </ol>
087     * <p>
088     * Missing or empty fields retain defaults; malformed time fields may likewise
089     * leave their defaults in place. This is a parser intended for data loading.
090     * </p>
091     * 
092     * @param ras RAS entry, such as
093     *            {@code <HomeActivity,Laundry,2026/10/20 09:00,2026/10/20 10:00,NIL>}.
094     * @throws RasException when RAS input is invalid.
095     */
096    public Activity(String ras)
097    throws RasException {
098        // declare default values
099        this("", new Time(), new Time());
100
101        RasParser.populate(this, ras);
102    }
103
104
105
106    /*
107     * Accessors
108     */
109   
110    /**
111     * Gets the title of this activity.
112     * 
113     * @return The activity title.
114     */
115    public String getTitle() {
116        return this.title;
117    }
118    
119    /**
120     * Gets the start time of this activity.
121     * 
122     * @return The activity start time.
123     */
124    public Time getStartTime() {
125        return this.startTime;
126    }
127  
128    /**
129     * Gets the end time of this activity.
130     * 
131     * @return The activity end time.
132     */
133    public Time getEndTime() {
134        return this.endTime;
135    }
136    
137    /**
138     * Gets the comment for this activity.
139     * 
140     * @return The activity comment, or <code>null</code> if none is defined.
141     */
142    public String getComment() {
143        return this.comment;
144    }
145
146
147
148    /**
149     * Returns the {@link dayplanner.ActivityType} that corresponds to this
150     * Activity.
151     * 
152     * @return Corresponding ActivityType. For regular Activities, this is
153     *         <code>null</code>.
154     */
155    public ActivityType getType() {
156        return null;
157    }
158
159
160
161    /*
162     * Mutators
163     */
164    
165    /**
166     * Sets the title of this activity.
167     * 
168     * @param title The new title; ignored if {@code null} or blank, leaving the old
169     *              title unchanged.
170     */
171    public void setTitle(String title) {
172        if (title != null && !title.isBlank())
173            this.title = title;
174    }
175
176    /**
177     * Sets the start time of this activity.
178     * 
179     * @param startTime The new start time; ignored if {@code null}. The reference
180     *                  is stored directly.
181     */
182    public void setStartTime(Time startTime) {
183        if (startTime != null)
184            this.startTime = startTime;
185    }
186
187    /**
188     * Sets the end time of this activity.
189     * 
190     * @param endTime The new end time; ignored if {@code null}; no ordering check
191     *                is performed.
192     */
193    public void setEndTime(Time endTime) {
194        if (endTime != null)
195            this.endTime = endTime;
196    }
197
198    /**
199     * Sets the comment for this activity.
200     * 
201     * @param comment The new comment; ignored if {@code null} or blank. A blank
202     *                value does not clear an existing comment.
203     */
204    public void setComment(String comment) {
205        if (comment != null && !comment.isBlank())
206            this.comment = comment;
207    }
208
209
210
211    /*
212     * Serialization
213     */
214
215    /**
216     * <p>
217     * Encodes this activity into RAS (Readable Activity Serial) format.
218     * </p>
219     * <p>
220     * The RAS format is a comma-separated list wrapped in angle brackets, for
221     * example:
222     * </p>
223     * 
224     * <pre>
225     * &lt;ClassName,title,YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM,YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM,comment&gt;
226     * </pre>
227     * <p>
228     * If no comment is set, <code>NIL</code> is used as a placeholder. For example,
229     * a <code>HomeActivity</code> titled "Morning Run" with no comment might
230     * produce:
231     * </p>
232     * 
233     * <pre>
234     * &lt;HomeActivity,Morning Run,2026/01/01 07:00,2026/01/01 08:00,NIL&gt;
235     * </pre>
236     * 
237     * @return A single-line RAS representation; commas in field values are not
238     *         escaped.
239     */
240    public String toRAS() {
241        return RasParser.serialize(this);
242    }
243
244
245
246    /*
247     * Object Overrides
248     */
249
250    /**
251     * Returns a string representation of this activity.
252     * 
253     * @return A string representation of this activity.
254     */
255    @Override
256    public String toString() {
257        String str = String.format("%s (%s - %s)",
258            getTitle(),
259            getStartTime().toString(),
260            getEndTime().toString());
261
262        String comment = getComment();
263        if (comment != null && !comment.isBlank())
264            str = str + " (" + comment + ")";
265
266        return str;
267    }
268
269    /**
270     * Determines whether this activity is equal to another activity.
271     * 
272     * @param other The other activity to compare with.
273     * @return <code>true</code> if both activities are equal, <code>false</code>
274     *         otherwise.
275     */
276    public boolean equals(Activity other) {
277        // compare the class first
278        // this is necessary because HomeActivity etc. are subclasses of this one
279        // and when comparing activities of different classes (i.e. HomeActivity and SchoolActivity),
280        // the two should always be treated as unequal
281        if (other == null || (getClass() != other.getClass()))
282            return false;
283
284        // compare title
285        if (getTitle() == null
286            ? other.getTitle() != null
287            : !getTitle().equals(other.getTitle()))
288            return false;
289
290        // compare start time
291        if (getStartTime() == null
292            ? other.getStartTime() != null
293            : !getStartTime().equals(other.getStartTime()))
294            return false;
295
296        // compare end time
297        if (getEndTime() == null
298            ? other.getEndTime() != null
299            : !getEndTime().equals(other.getEndTime()))
300            return false;
301        
302        // if we get here the only difference should be the comment
303        String c1 = getComment();
304        String c2 = other.getComment();
305        if (c1 == null || c1.isBlank())
306            return c2 == null || c2.isBlank();
307        else
308            return c1.equals(c2);
309    }
310
311    /**
312     * Determines whether this activity is equal to another object.
313     * 
314     * @param other The object to compare with.
315     * @return <code>true</code> if the objects are equal, <code>false</code>
316     *         otherwise.
317     */
318    @Override
319    public boolean equals(Object other) {
320        if (this == other)
321            return true;
322        if (other == null || getClass() != other.getClass())
323            return false;
324        return equals((Activity) other);
325    }
326
327    /**
328     * Compares this activity with another activity based on starting time.
329     * 
330     * @param other The other activity to compare with.
331     * @return A negative integer, zero, or a positive integer as this activity's
332     *         start time precedes, equals, or follows the other activity's start
333     *         time. Equal start times compare as zero even if other fields differ.
334     */
335    @Override
336    public int compareTo(Activity other) {
337        // since we are comparing based on a Time,
338        // which has its own compareTo method,
339        // we can just piggyback off of that method :)
340        return getStartTime().compareTo(other.getStartTime());
341    }
342}
